From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Apr 2024 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PoC cadence & success criteria — Redwood <> Stratus.ai

Thanks for taking the call this morning, Aisha — quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment before we lock calendar invites.

Key discovery highlights
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and latency for batch document inference while preserving >=99.5% extraction F1 on your internal NER pipeline.
- Expected peak throughput: ~20k docs/day, burst to 5k docs/hour during batch runs.
- Security: S3-based test data, SOC2 controls required, customer-managed KMS for keys.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm/edit)
1) Latency: average inference latency for batch job under 200ms per request for the 95th percentile.
2) Cost: token cost reduction >= 40% vs current endpoint during productionized batch runs.
3) Quality: NER F1 remains within 0.5 points of baseline on your evaluation set.
4) Reliability: 99.9% job completion for scheduled batch runs (no more than 1 failure/week).

Suggested PoC timeline (flexible):
- Kickoff: week of Apr 15 (30–60 min executive + technical sync)
- Integration window: Apr 16–Apr 26 (SE integration, S3 access, test harness)
- Weekly 30m check-ins: Tuesdays at 10:00am PT starting Apr 23
- Final readout: May 9–10 (30m business readout + technical postmortem)

Owners
- Redwood owner / AE: Marcus Lin — program lead, customer alignment & procurement support
- Redwood SE: Priyom Das — integration, test harness, runbook
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole — success metrics, readout facilitation
- Stratus owner: Aisha Khan — evaluation signoff, test data & access
- Stratus infra contact: brian.tang@stratus.ai — S3/KMS coordination

Attachments: Stratus_PoC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (proposed rubric)

Next steps
- Aisha: confirm success criteria and whether the timeline looks OK by EOD Wed (Apr 10)
- Redwood: send calendar hold for kickoff week + draft kickoff agenda
- Stratus infra: share sample payload (or a synthetic CSV) and preferred S3 path

Thanks — happy to adjust.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@stratus.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Apr 2024 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC cadence & success criteria — Redwood <> Stratus.ai

Thanks Marcus — this is great and captures our notes closely. A few edits from our side:

- Quality target: rather than absolute F1 delta, can we measure relative F1 on our "validation-2024Q1" set (I'll share identifiers)? Aim: within 0.4 points.
- Latency: 95th percentile under 250ms is acceptable for the first pass; if we can get to 200ms that's ideal.
- Cost: target of 35–45% reduction depending on batching — happy with the proposed 40% midpoint.

I looped in infra (brian.tang@stratus.ai) who will provide S3 path and temporary role access. I'll also have security fill out your standard questionnaire — expect that by Tue.

We can do kickoff the week of Apr 15; Tue/Thu mornings PT are best for our team. I'll confirm by EOD Wed.

Attached: stratus-expected-load.csv (sample daily volumes)

Aisha Khan
Head of ML Platform
Stratus.ai
